items.t: Said he believes in First Amendment rights but that the founding fathers did not include in the First Amendment the ability to lie about somebody.
items.q: I’m a firm believer in our First Amendment right, but I also believe that our founding fathers did not include in the First Amendment as being able to lie about somebody," Moyle said.
